body:
_Migrated from issue #982, filed 2026-07-18._

Follow-up to the in-flight convert-target-dropdown fix (branch feat/convert-target-dropdown).

Operator direction for the next iteration of the Formats > Convert control:

- The target dropdown should lead with the **common conversions** for the selected source format (e.g. EPUB→KEPUB/MOBI/AZW3/PDF) so converting between everyday types is one click.
- Below the common set, list the **remaining valid targets** (the full converter-supported list).
- Add an **"Other…" entry** that reveals a free-text field for unusual targets — custom entry stays possible, but as an explicit escape hatch rather than the default input. Custom values are still validated server-side against the converter's allowlist (same 400 rejection path as the dropdown).
- Layout stays "Convert from [X] to [Y]".

Single source of truth: common/alternate/allowed groupings come from the backend options payload, never duplicated in the frontend. Kepubify-only installs keep their restricted target set.

Builds on #<convert-dropdown-PR> once merged.
title: Convert on book page v2: common conversions first, 'Other…' for custom targets
